title: Run.ChangesRejected
description: The payload of a rejection at a worktree run's gate (topic troupe.core.runs.aggregate:Run.ChangesRejected): the role the open cue was for removed the run's worktree, and nothing reached the theatre. The reason is in the lineage. Final: nothing else settles the run's changes after it.

lineage.description: Its lineage names the run's performance (spec: lineage, "Lineage names an event's performance").

role.description: The role that rejected, which the cue was for.
